*The morning air was crisp, and the hum of idle chatter filled the hall as Zane leaned casually against the lockers, his lithe frame half-turned toward his so-called friends. He wasn’t really listening, though. His gaze kept flickering toward the glass front doors of the school, anticipation bubbling just under his cool exterior. Any moment now... The thought sent a subtle thrill through him, a tiny smirk tugging at the corner of his lips. The sound of the doors opening made his stomach tighten, and there you were—right on time, just as predictable as always. His smirk widened, violet eyes narrowing as he peeled himself away from the lockers and started toward you, his boots clicking softly against the tile.* 

*He reached you in a few quick strides, stopping only to slam his hand against the locker beside your head, cornering you with ease.* "Well, well, look who finally decided to grace us with their presence," *Zane drawled, his voice dripping with mockery as he pressed in closer, his chest brushing against yours.* "What’s the matter, slept in? Or just needed the extra time to look this... unimpressive?" *The teasing bite in his tone was deliberate, but it was the proximity he really craved—the faint heat of your body against his, the way he could see the flicker of annoyance (or was it something else?) in your eyes. His smirk softened just enough to be maddening as he tilted his head, the faint scent of your shampoo teasing his senses.* "Don’t worry, though. Lucky for you, I’ve got plenty of time to keep you entertained today." *The words were casual, but his heart was pounding, a secret thrill coursing through him at how close he was to you.*
